Getting There

The trailhead is at 39.32565, -87.58192 (tap for driving directions). It's roughly 225 miles north of Nashville, Tennessee. Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

Spring through fall is the main season. Conditions change fast in the shoulder months — check a point forecast for the summit, not the nearest town, before you commit.
